text:
emily_revops: Hey team — flagged a recurring problem in the weekly CS dashboard: stale accounts aren’t getting auto-flagged for outreach and renewal risk scoring is off for accounts with 'pending PO'. Can we quick-sync on a short term playbook + an automation to clean CRM tags? :thinking_face:

anna_cs: Yep saw that too. A lot of accounts sitting in 'trial' with no activity for 60+ days. Current health score rules don't account for invoice/PO state.

michael_csm: Do we have a reliable signal for "stale"? I can run an export but better to bake it into a saved search.

jordan_ops: Proposed quick filter (SQL for SF export):
```sql
SELECT id, account_name, last_touch, stage, po_status
FROM accounts
WHERE stage IN ('trial','onboarding')
  AND last_touch < (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days')
  AND is_active = true;
```
Use this to seed a playbook run.

emily_revops: Nice. For immediate relief can we add a rule in automation engine to tag accounts as "stale_60d" and then kick off the playbook? Minimal risk.

sarah_cx: I can draft the playbook steps: 1) CS email nudge, 2) schedule 15m check-in, 3) flag renewal risk as 'low/med/high' after outreach. Want to include a quick template for the email.

anna_cs: Also need to account for 'pending PO' — if PO exists but no product usage treat health as 'at-risk' but add owner note to not auto-churn. 

emily_revops: Agree. Here's a tiny YAML snippet for the automation rule we can drop into the engine (copy as starting point):
```yaml
rule_name: stale_60d_auto_tag
match: 
  stage: [trial, onboarding]
  last_touch_days_gt: 60
actions:
  - tag: stale_60d
  - start_playbook: cs_stale_outreach_v1
  - assign: owner_from_account_team
exclusions:
  - po_status: active
```

michael_csm: If we do that, we should also patch health scoring: add +20 penalty if tag == stale_60d, but -10 if PO pending (so it doesn't get misclassified as churn-ready).

jordan_ops: I'll add the tagging rule to sandbox and run a dry-run for the last 90 days to see how many hits. ETA: 2 business days.

sarah_cx: I'll draft the outreach templates this afternoon and drop them in the shared doc. Will include a short survey link to capture why they're idle.

emily_revops: Can we create two actionable items and owners here so we don't lose momentum?

anna_cs: Action 1: Jordan — implement tagging rule in sandbox + dry-run (owner: jordan_ops, due: 1762200000).

michael_csm: Action 2: Sarah — create playbook + email templates + update health score rules doc (owner: sarah_cx, due: 1762170000).

triage-bot: Reminder set: follow-up in 3 days for status updates.

emily_revops: Great. If the dry-run looks reasonable we'll schedule a quick 15m sync to approve push to prod. Thanks all :raised_hands:

anna_cs: Quick note — when you run the dry-run, include a column for ARR and last_billing_date so we prioritize outreach by revenue.

jordan_ops: Will do. Adding ARR filter to the dry-run query.

michael_csm: 👍 Also recommend adding a metric to CS dashboard: "stale_accounts_count" + weekly trend so PMs can see impact.

emily_revops: Perfect. Keeping this thread for progress. Ping me if you hit blockers.
